programme.title: Full Fight: Gaethje v. Cobb
programme.desc: In a back and forth 3 round bout, undefeated lightweight prospect Justin Gaethje (8-0) takes on MMA veteran Brian Cobb (20-7) at WSOF 3, 2013.

programme.title: Full Fight: Gaethje v. Firmino
programme.desc: In the WSOFNYC main event, undefeated lightweight kingpin Justin The Highlight Gaethje (16-0) defends his crown against Luiz Buscape Firmino (19-7). WSOFNYC featured an unprecedented New Years Eve world championship extravaganza at The Theater at Madison Square Garden in New York City.

programme.title: Full Fight: Gaethje v. Foster
programme.desc: In the lightweight championship main event, undefeated champ Justin Gaethje (15-0) attempts to defend his throne against Brian Foster (26-8) at WSOF 29, 2016.

programme.title: Full Fight: Gaethje v. Guillard
programme.desc: In the peoples main event, undefeated contedner and fan favorite Justin Gaethje (12-0) takes on Melvin Guillard (32-13-2) in a catchweight bout at WSOF 15, 2014. The hostility between the two fighters during fight week made this the most anticipated bout of the weekend.

programme.title: Full Fight: Gaethje v. Lauzon
programme.desc: In his third fight in the WSOF, undefeated knockout artist Justin Gaethje (9-0) accepts the challenge from MMA veteran Dan Lauzon (17-4) at WSOF 6, 2013.

programme.title: Full Fight: Gaethje v. Newell
programme.desc: The first ever WSOF lightweight king Justin Gaethje (11-0) attempts his first title defense against undefeated contender Nick Newell (11-0) at WSOF 11, 2014.

programme.title: Full Fight: Gaethje v. Palomino 1
programme.desc: In what many consider one of the best fights in the history of WSOF, and the Fight of the Year for 2015, lightweight champ Justin Gaethje (13-0) faces Luis Palomino (23-9) in an epic battle. Gaethje vs Palomino in the main event of WSOF 19, 2015.

programme.title: Full Fight: Gaethje v. Palomino 2
programme.desc: In a rematch of one of the best fights in WSOF history, undefeated lightweight champ Justin Gaethje (14-0) attempts to defend his belt against Luis Palomino (23-10) for the second time. Gaethje vs Palomino 2 in the main event of WSOF 23, 2015.

programme.title: S3E2 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike brings you heart-pounding downhill action from the Mountain of Hell in Les Alpes, France. Watch GoPro athlete Antoni Villoni, downhill master, as he navigates crashes, weaves through expert trails, and powers down 7,800 vertical feet of snow-capped peaks, dusty singletracks, and technical terrain. Hundreds of riders take on this epic race, where only speed, skill, and courage decide who reaches the finish line first. The rules are simple: first one to cross the line wins...

programme.title: S4E1 Bike
programme.desc: When the sun sets, GoPro Awards recipient Nikolaj Juhlsen lights up the Austrian forest on his downhill mountain bike, GoPro MAX mounted and headlamp blazing. Watch Jonny Livorti take on a daring staircase ride overlooking the Italian Riviera, where speed, finesse, and bravery are essential for this epic descent in Liguria, Italy. Why hike when you can mountain bike? Experience jaw-dropping trails, fearless riders, and the ultimate daredevil MTB action.

programme.title: S1E1 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike delivers nonstop action with the world’s top riders. Watch Rachel Atherton, downhill champion, tear through Arrowhead, CA, Aaron Gwin, gravity master, and Steve Storey, trail innovator, dominate Trail Boik Time. Join Remy Metailler, freestyle phenom, in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, and see Gee Atherton, enduro legend, and Dan Atherton, mountain bike pioneer, push speed, skill, and style to the max.

programme.title: S1E1 Skate
programme.desc: This episode features the inspiring story of founders Miguel and Isabel. Driven by the belief that kids should be free to just be kids, #GoProForACause partner SanSkate is making a real difference in their community. Their mission is to provide a safe space for children who enter the workforce at a young age, giving them a chance to set aside their struggles and enjoy skateboarding. The episode also showcases the very best of GoPro skateboarding, featuring incredible talent from Andrew Brophy, Sewa Kroetkov, Madars Apse, and more.

programme.title: S1E2 Skate
programme.desc: Watch the inspiring story of Mike Rogers, an all-around skateboarding star from Cocoa Beach, FL. A regular competitor at top events around the world, including the Vans Pro-Tec Pool Party, Vans Bowl-A-Rama at Bondi Beach, and the Clash at Clairemont, Mike showcases his skill, style, and dedication to the sport. The episode also features Leticia Bufoni and Cata Diaz as she shares her perspective on women in skateboarding and explains why MACBA in Barcelona has become a world-renowned destination for skaters, with its iconic plaza, unique architecture, and perfectly smooth concrete.

programme.title: S1E3 Skate
programme.desc: Experience the very best of GoPro skateboarding at MACBA, Barcelona, celebrated worldwide as the ultimate Spanish skateboarding mecca. In 2018, we teamed up with Macba Life to follow the local skating community and capture the most jaw-dropping tricks this iconic plaza has to offer. Don’t miss this unforgettable collaboration with #MacbaLife.

programme.title: S2E1 Skate
programme.desc: The very best of GoPro skateboarding including pro skateboarders Sean Malto, Chris Cole & Leticia Bufoni.

programme.title: S1E1 Two Roads
programme.desc:
“Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today.
This episode features Olympic bronze medalist Kristian Ipsen, American rugby union star Carlin Isles — celebrated as “The Fastest Man in Rugby” — and his remarkable rise from track and field and American football to becoming a two-time Olympian in rugby sevens. You’ll also meet Allison Stokke, a record-breaking high school pole vaulter who went on to compete at UC Berkeley, and Miles Chamley-Watson, a British-American fencing champion whose career includes 13 team Pan American titles, a 2019 team world championship, a 2013 individual world championship, three Olympic appearances, and a 2016 team Olympic bronze medal.

programme.title: S1E2 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Trenten Merrill, an American Paralympic long jumper who claimed bronze at the 2020 Summer Paralympics. Also featured is Casey Patterson, a powerhouse in professional beach volleyball with numerous AVP tournament wins, a gold medal on the FIVB World Tour, and an appearance at the 2016 Rio Olympics alongside Jake Gibb. Tennis legends Bob and Mike Bryan, the most successful doubles team in history, take the spotlight with 16 Grand Slam titles, 119 ATP Tour doubles victories, 438 weeks as the world’s No. 1 team, and Olympic gold in 2012. Rounding out the episode is acclaimed gymnastics coach Liang Chow, celebrated for guiding Gabby Douglas to the 2012 Olympic all-around gold and coaching Shawn Johnson to multiple medals at the 2008 Olympics.

programme.title: S1E3 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Paul Rabil, legendary professional lacrosse player and co-founder of the Premier Lacrosse League, celebrated as one of the greatest in the sport’s history. Also featured is Britney Henry, a standout track and field athlete from the University of Oregon who captured the Pac-10 Conference title in the hammer throw. Rounding out the episode is Meagan Martin, trailblazing competitor as the first female rookie to complete the American Ninja Warrior course and the first-ever Women’s Champion of the series.

programme.title: S1E1 Draft Story
programme.desc: In Part 1, we uncover the story of Tyvis Powell and the people who shaped him into the man and football player he is today. His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S1 E2 Draft Story
programme.desc: A Draft Story” Part 2 is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he takes the leap into professional football. Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: S1E1 Lucha
programme.desc: Ian Hodgkinson, known as Vampiro in the world of wrestling, was a famed wrestler in the late 80’s and 90’s. Today, he shifted his career to being behind the scenes as a Story Producer for AAA, the top wrestling company in Lucha Libre. Hodgkinson intimately peels back the curtain on the mysteries of this show, how it’s produced, and what life is like on and off the stage. We dive deep in to the lives of two wrestlers and follow their stories as they prep for their next fight: El Hijo Del Fantasma, an up and coming star who seemingly has it all, as well as Faby Apache, a veteran female wrestler struggling to stay relevant as she raises her son.

programme.title: S1E1 Moto
programme.desc: Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa on the adventure of a lifetime as they explore the vibrant cities and stunning beaches of Morocco. Plus, enjoy exclusive bonus footage featuring the very best of GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E2 Moto
programme.desc: The journey continues as we follow two brothers on their 2,300-kilometer adventure across Morocco. Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa as they experience vibrant cities, breathtaking beaches, and the adventure of a lifetime. Plus, enjoy bonus footage of Jeremy Seewer. With 50 podiums, 11 victories, 17 race wins, and five FIM Motocross World Championship silver medals, his record is remarkable — yet his story goes far beyond the numbers.

programme.title: S2E1 Moto
programme.desc: Celebrate the women of GoPro, including British rally driver Catie Munnings, who rose to fame after winning the FIA European Rally Championship Ladies Trophy at just 18. Watch snowboarder Alina Hight who made history as the first to land a double backside alley-oop rodeo in a halfpipe competition. Meet Teigan Nash, co-founder of Girls Who Glow, inspiring young women everywhere. Plus, experience even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S3E1 Moto
programme.desc: GoPro Athlete and Formula 1 star Daniel Ricciardo teams up with Race Service Co-Founder James Kirkham for an unforgettable ride through Los Angeles. With eight Grand Prix victories and 32 podiums to his name, the Honey Badger spends his day off behind the wheel of supercars like the Ford GT, racing past Beverly Hills, the Sunset Strip, and into the winding roads of Benedict Canyon. Plus, enjoy even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S2E1 Animals
programme.desc: GoPro Animals delivers heartwarming, hilarious, and jaw-dropping moments from the animal world. From Golden Retrievers, French Bulldogs, and Border Collies bringing endless puppy smiles, to rescuing orcas and swimming with humpback whales, this show has it all. Wildlife photographer Chris Barnard captures the wild up close, even surviving a giraffe’s mighty kick. Plus, join Ocean Conservation Namibia as they race to save seals trapped in deadly ocean debris. A must-watch for every animal lover.

programme.title: S1E1 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

programme.title: S1E2 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you inside the world of pro cycling and mountain biking. Follow Peter Sagan, multi-time World Champion, as his story unfolds, watch Loic Bruni, downhill superstar, conquer thrilling courses, and join Geoff Gulevich, trail master, as he charges through British Columbia’s most scenic and technical singletrack in an all-out Trail Party. Adventure, speed, and skill collide in every ride.

programme.title: S1E3 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you on the world’s most thrilling rides. Watch GoPro athletes Sam Pilgrim, urban downhill master, and Nicholi Rogatkin, freestyle powerhouse, tackle the Downhill Challenge Medellín, the longest urban downhill race, with #HyperSmooth. Then join Gee, Rachel, and Dan Atherton, enduro and downhill champions, as they ride together through heart-pounding terrain. Speed, skill, and adrenaline collide in every unforgettable moment.

programme.title: WPT Ladies Championship 2023 - Part 1
programme.desc: The Final Table of the first ever WPT Ladies Championship at Wynn Las Vegas is set. Kathy Liebert, Jamie Kerstetter, Olga Iermolcheva, Lina Niu, Cindy Spier, and Dusti Smith round out our final six. Find out who has what it takes to become the first WPT Ladies Champion and take home the first place prize of $105,136.

programme.title: WPT Ladies Championship 2023 - Part 2
programme.desc: Six talented poker competitors remain in the first ever WPT Ladies Championship. Lina Niu has the chip lead, but Olga Iermolcheva is right on her heels. Tension is rising as the short stacks are being forced to make their move to stay alive. It’s anyone’s game as final table action gets back underway at Wynn Las Vegas.

programme.title: WPT Ladies Championship 2023 - Part 3
programme.desc: One of poker’s top female earners of all time, Kathy Leibert finds herself as the shortest stack at the table with only four women remaining. Watch Kathy reach into her bag of tricks as she attempts to battle back in hopes of becoming the first ever WPT Ladies Champion.

programme.title: WPT Ladies Championship 2023 - Part 4
programme.desc: Only three ladies remain in the battle for over $100,000 and the title of WPT Ladies Champion. Olga Iermolcheva has a commanding chip lead, but her competitors are showing no signs of backing down. Prepare for plenty of thrilling poker action under the lights at Wynn Las Vegas as we play down to the crowning of the first ever WPT Ladies Champion.

programme.title: WPT Prime Championship 2023 - Part 1
programme.desc: The final table of the inaugural WPT Prime Championship at Wynn Las Vegas is underway. The $2 million guaranteed prizepool event saw a record-setting turnout of 5,430 entries, nearly tripling the guarantee, which means that the eventual winner will walk away with over $700,000 and the title of the first ever WPT Prime Champion.

programme.title: WPT Prime Championship 2023 - Part 2
programme.desc: We are down to the final four players of the first ever WPT Prime Championship. With so much at stake, nobody is willing to settle for anything less than first place. Over $700,000 will be awarded to the victor. Don’t miss a second of the action as WPT high stakes tournament poker action continues at Wynn Las Vegas.

programme.title: WPT Prime Championship 2023 - Part 3
programme.desc: Big pots are being pushed all around the table as the final four players of the WPT Prime Championship battle for a first place prize of over $700,000 and the title of WPT Prime Champion. Unpredictable bluffs and big bets for value are in abundance as the WPT Prime Championship final table continues at Wynn Las Vegas.

programme.title: WPT Prime Championship 2023 - Part 4
programme.desc: The final three players battle it out at the final table of the WPT Prime Championship where the winner will receive $712,650 to go along with the title of WPT Prime Champion. The fans are fired up and the players are focused on the task at hand. Join us as we crown the first ever WPT Prime Champion.

programme.title: WPT World Championship at Wynn Las Vegas 2023 - Part 1

Nine players remain to contend for a first place payout of $4.1 million along with the honor of having their name forever inscribed on the Mike Sexton WPT Champions Cup. programme.desc: Jonathan Ferguson, a weapons expert and Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries, breaks down the weaponry of Grand Theft Auto 5, including a pink Rocket Launcher, an uncharacteristically quiet Desert Eagle, and a blinged out AK47. programme.title: GTA 5's Franklin Reacts To Grand Theft Auto V
programme.desc: Shawn Solo Fonteno, aka Franklin from Grand Theft Auto 5, joins us to break down viral scenes from the game as well as GTA Online's The Contract missions. 00:00 Introduction 00:15 Franklin talks to a dog mission 02:22 Franklin gets roasted by Lamar 05:20 Trevor falls over 09:08 Franklin in GTA Online's The Contract 12:58 Chop 13:58 Choosing ending C 18:28 Outro It's hard to believe it's been almost a decade since GTA 5 launched, partly because it is still getting updated and brought to current-gen consoles, and partly because its multiplayer counterpart, GTA Online, is still getting meaningful updates. Take its most recent update, The Contract, for example, not only did it pull in heavyweights Dr Dre and DJ Pooh, but also brought back GTA 5 protagonist Franklin. To celebrate, we brought in Franklin's actor, Shawn 'Solo' Fonteno, to discuss what it was like making GTA 5, and to react to some of the game's most popular clips. In the above video, he describes what it was like to work with both the real and fake Chop the dog, his experience learning Franklin's role in the story, as well as the origins of the infamous Franklin gets roasted clip. Check out Shawn's book here: https://sologamechanger.com/book/ https://twitter.com/Shawn_Fonteno #GTA5 #GrandTheftAuto5

programme.title: GTA 5's Franklin Reacts To Grand Theft Auto V
programme.desc: Shawn Solo Fonteno, aka Franklin from Grand Theft Auto 5, joins us to break down viral scenes from the game as well as GTA Online's The Contract missions. 00:00 Introduction 00:15 Franklin talks to a dog mission 02:22 Franklin gets roasted by Lamar 05:20 Trevor falls over 09:08 Franklin in GTA Online's The Contract 12:58 Chop 13:58 Choosing ending C 18:28 Outro It's hard to believe it's been almost a decade since GTA 5 launched, partly because it is still getting updated and brought to current-gen consoles, and partly because its multiplayer counterpart, GTA Online, is still getting meaningful updates. Take its most recent update, The Contract, for example, not only did it pull in heavyweights Dr Dre and DJ Pooh, but also brought back GTA 5 protagonist Franklin. To celebrate, we brought in Franklin's actor, Shawn 'Solo' Fonteno, to discuss what it was like making GTA 5, and to react to some of the game's most popular clips. In the above video, he describes what it was like to work with both the real and fake Chop the dog, his experience learning Franklin's role in the story, as well as the origins of the infamous Franklin gets roasted clip. Check out Shawn's book here: https://sologamechanger.com/book/ https://twitter.com/Shawn_Fonteno #GTA5 #GrandTheftAuto5

programme.title: Assisting the Home Team
programme.desc: Torch surprises her high school girls' basketball team with new equipment; the team visits an organization in Chicago where they meet asylum seekers transitioning into U.S. life; Hammer surprises viral sensation Zeke "The Trick Shot Kid" in Georgia.

programme.title: Behind The Scenes Ep. 1
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at part of the Globetrotters 2017 season.

programme.title: Love and Basketball
programme.desc: Hotshot, Torch, and Cheese break bread with a LA based group that provides birthday parties to kids experiencing homelessness. Then the Globetrotters partake in a cooking competition with world-renowned chef, Marcus Samuelson. Moose takes the court in Venice Beach to show us the science behind his behind the back shot. Kenny Smith Hosts.

programme.title: Honorable Adventures
programme.desc: The team highlights their greatest showmen. The Harlem Globetrotters perform for servicemen and their families during a visit to Moody Air Force Base. Plus, Hammer surprises viral sensation Zeke "The Trick Shot Kid." Cheese, Wham, Hammer, and Hotshot learn about some amazing animals at a theme park in Georgia.

programme.title: My Rookie Season Ep. 2
programme.desc: The annual Harlem Globetrotters Training Camp welcomes new rookies and fans get a look behind the curtain to see what it takes to make the team and what it truly means to be a Harlem Globetrotter.

programme.title: World-Record Dunk at Disney: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: This video features the Harlem Globetrotters showcasing their legendary basketball skills and entertaining performances. The footage highlights record-breaking moments, fan interactions, and the history of the team, emphasizing their global impact and influence on the sport. From exciting game highlights and interviews with players like Shawn Williams to behind-the-scenes glimpses of their tours and community engagement programs, the video celebrates the Harlem Globetrotters' legacy as the greatest entertainers and ambassadors of basketball. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc:
In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range.
Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots.
From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc:
In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves.
As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field.
With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: For many protected reserves across Africa, the elephant populations are expanding, and this comes with a critical problem: what happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh

programme.title: Gone Bananas - Graveyard Carz

Mark and Daren visit the local AAMCO Transmissions to watch the overhaul of the 1970 Barracuda Convertible's 727 Automatic Transmission, and then the Barracuda has its A/C box and instrument panel installed. The 1970 Superbird assembly nears completion.

programme.title: MoSparring - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Automotive parts supplier Tony D'Agostino of Tony's Parts helps the shop get organized, and Mark tests his Mopar knowledge against Tony's. Work on a 1970 Plymouth Superbird is completed.

programme.title: The Hills Have Eyes on a Superbird - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The 1970 Superbird's restoration and story is recapped, and the Hills visit the shop to take delivery of the car, along with its original owner. Mike and Michael Hill drive the Superbird on a cross county trip home to South Carolina.

programme.title: Clipped Wings - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With the 1970 Plymouth Superbird done and safely driven home, Mark is asked to restore a 1969 Daytona Charger. Due to its condition, Mark questions if it's practical and if it's even legal.

programme.title: Put Me In, Coach - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Just when things couldn't get more stressful, Mark agrees to finally get the 1930 Chevy Coach fully restored by the end of the week. Meanwhile, Mark QC's the next cars in the process of resurrection.

programme.title: How to Cook a Barracuda - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: See the complete 3-year restoration of Kimberly Cook's 1970 Barracuda Convertible: the body, paint, engine, and convertible top, culminating in Graveyard Carz' most emotional reveal to date.

programme.title: Commando Cuda vs. Magnum Force - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: New shop. New crew. An All-new Graveyard Carz! The ghouls tackle a 1970 Cuda.

programme.title: Rallye Red Restored - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark paints a Hemi Charger in his favorite Mopar color, burnt orange. AMD delivers the Phantom Cuda, and the ghouls finish the Dailey's 1970 Cuda 383, a project four years in the making.

programme.title: Hell Hath No '58 Fury - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls wrap up the 340 Cuda and install panels on the Hemi Charger. Mark trains Allysa on O.E.M. assembly line markings. The legendary red Plymouth Fury "Christine" visits the shop.

programme.title: 400 Magnum Misfire - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls have problems with after-market parts for the 400 Magnum V8. Allysa begins working in the shop, and two rare Mopars are disassembled

programme.title: Return of the '70 Sunroof Challenger - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark's coffee addiction is spotlighted, and the ghouls work on a 1970 Challenger.

programme.title: 70 'Cuda Grace - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Work on a 1970 Cuda 340 is featured.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Daily Driver Transformation Part 2
programme.desc: Nick Rutter showcases the products and process to restore the finish of a 10-year-old vehicle using a rotary and dual action polisher, protecting with a graphene ceramic coating and also restores the faded plastic trim.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Family Truckster Restoration Part 1
programme.desc: Nick Rutter walks you through step-by-step on how to remove stubborn bug splatter from your vehicle along with tips and techniques for using a waterless wash as well as a clay bar.

programme.title: Truck U - Better Than Stock

programme.title: Truck U - Wheels For Hope

programme.title: Truck U - Budget Rear End
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno upgrade the Dana 35 rear end in a 2000 Jeep TJ to a much stronger Ford 8.8 one and do it for under $500.

programme.title: Truck U - Warning Lights
programme.desc: Every light on your dashboard means something. Matt and Bruno diagnose and repair a vehicle that came to the shop to them with warning lights.

programme.title: Truck U - Road Ranger
programme.desc: Nobody likes to fix a truck on the side of the road. That’s why there’s roadside assistance. Matt and Bruno take a stock F250 and turn it into a purpose-built Road Ranger.

programme.title: Truck U - Jeep Build-Off Day 1
programme.desc: With two days and a ton of truck parts anything can happen. Matt and Bruno put together build teams to see who can complete the toughest rig.

programme.title: Truck U - Jeep Build-Off Day 2
programme.desc: The Jeep Build-Off continues as the guys get a chance to finish their Jeeps and take them on a Geocaching race for all of the marbles.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Beetles, Bugs, and Buses, Oh My!
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Tigger v. Monster Muscle
programme.desc: Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: Exotic Car Hunter - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Andrew Jones' Super Jeep
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Jekyll and Hide - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.desc: Tony teams up with the Auto Archeologist, Ryan Brutt, to uncover one of the rarest Dodge Demons in existence. Then Tony follows the trail to make an offer on a movie-star, an Eleanor Mustang. With this deal, the sky's the limit!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Yellow Taxi
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Peach State Challengers
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Lambo Racer
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Boston's (Un)Common Collection - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: C&O at the Beach - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Kenny Roger's Family Values - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - SEMA: Inside Fuller's Head
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Motor Masters
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - HOT ROD HOLY GRAIL
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - CORVETTE SINK HOLE
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - ROAR AT THE SHORE
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - CARS AND MUSIC STARS
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DRAGSTER DIPLOMACY
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - SMOKIN JOE
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BOARD TRACK BATTLES
programme.desc: In the early 1900s, race tracks built of wood sprang up across the country drawing crowds of 50,000 and more. Ray and Xtreme sports superstar Travis Pastrana break down the Battle on the Boards.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Viva Cuba!
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Magnus Walker's Secret Porsche Collection
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Chipper Jones' International Car Show - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.

programme.title: Fuller's "2029" Majestic Build - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Back to the future with a Majestic build from Fuller Moto that showcases 3-D printed parts, an electric motor, and hub-centric steering.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - The Fastest Man on Two Wheels
programme.desc: Horsepower and million-dollar sticker shock, from two and four wheels, dominate this edition of C & O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Power Play: Proline's Search for 3000+ HP
programme.desc: A need for speed in a Sleepy Georgia town has engineers pushing the boundaries to exceed 3000 horsepower.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Turn of the Century Cars
programme.desc: Turn of the century cars?with wooden wheels?at 85mph?oh my!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Hot Wheel's & an Urban Outlaw
programme.desc: Urban Outlaw and designer Magnus Walker weighs in on his beloved Porsche and the legend of Hot Wheels.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Dropping that C-10
programme.desc: When the guys get their hands on a clean 1986 square-body C-10, they give it a facelift…and a suspension drop. With its brand-new look and stance, Willie and Kevin can’t wait to reveal the truck to its owner.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Pretty Fly for a GTI
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie have an Autobahn edition 2013 MK6 VW GTI in the shop for performance upgrades. With a new turbo kit, exhaust, and a few other improvements, the guys plan to boost this car’s status from “daily driver” to “head-turner.”

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Double Truck Trouble
programme.desc: A friend of Kevin and Willie has not one, but two work trucks that need improvements for hauling heavy loads. Can the guys handle this double-order and finish both trucks in time for the owner to get them back on the job?

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Moab Ready
programme.desc: If you’re headed for the formidable Moab Desert, your Jeep had better be ready for anything. Willie and Kevin are outfitting a Wrangler TJ and a Cherokee XJ to handle the harsh environment of the desert.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - WeatherTech Bound
programme.desc: Kevin hits the road to Bolingbrook, Illinois to find out what it takes to proudly display “Made in America”, as he tours WeatherTech to see how they make all those great American products.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Can’t Stop This Mini
programme.desc: The guys have a Mini Cooper S in the shop today. They add some horsepower, some stopping power, and fix up a worn-out suspension to improve handling. Then they see if they can even fit in it for the test drive!

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: For decades, upper mid-range sedans have stood for the ideal combination of luxury, technology, and performance, especially for families and long distance travels. We put the hybrid Mercedes E 300 e and the fully electric VW ID.7 to the test.

programme.title: Vive la Evolution
programme.desc: For decades, French cars have combined extravagant design and innovation. The DS brand represents luxury and cutting-edge technology from Citroen. Does this also apply to the DS4? And: we tested the Peugeot 408 crossover SUV in Spain.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The Seat Ibiza turns 40 and we take a look back at the successes and highlights of this small car. And the big comparison: Mitsubishi ASX competes against its sister models Nissan Juke and Renault Captur. Which is better?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Cars from Asia are successful worldwide and there is an enormous variety. The Subaru BRZ with 234 hp and incredible handling offers adrenaline rushes at a low price. And: how good is the new Mitsubishi Colt compared to the competition?

programme.title: Has engine-tuner AMG reached the end of the road? What can be pimped in the electric AMG EQE 53?
programme.desc: Mercedes in-house tuner AMG has taken the electric E-Class EQE under its wing and unleashes the EQE 53 with 687 hp peak power. An impressive 1000 newtonmeters of maximum torque catapults the electric AMG to 100 km/h in just 3.3 seconds.

programme.title: Maserati Levante S
programme.desc: The Levante aims to be not just a Maserati SUV, but 'the Maserati of SUVs'.

programme.title: The Camaro 50th Anniversary Edition
programme.desc: 50 years of the Chevrolet Camaro. The American brand is celebrating with a special model with 453 hp. We tested the coupé in the foothills of the Alps.

programme.title: Ignition GT

programme.desc: The team compares the Mercedes-Benz GLC and Audi Q5 as used premium SUVs, examines whether an out-of-warranty Ranger with a wet belt is worth keeping, and asks when it's finally time to replace a high-mileage workhorse.

programme.title: Garage Gold
programme.desc: We go off-road with a bunch of Ford Model Ts and explore some of the best Nissan and Datsun models in South Africa.

programme.title: Petrolheads

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A trend is on the rise: going on mountain cruises in a sports car. As super cars become more comfortable and suitable for travelling in spite of their ever-increasing performance, what would be the perfect sports car for taking on the Alps: the Lamborghini Aventador Miura Homage, the Ferrari 458 Speciale, the McLaren 570S or the Porsche 911 Turbo S?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: To drive or be driven: That is the question for people who can afford such a choice. When it comes to the Bentley Mulsanne with its extended wheelbase, one could be more delighted to sit in the back of the car than in the front. But what is the situation when it comes to the sporty Maserati Quattroporte? Or the upgraded BMW 7 series by Alpina with the model name B7? Or the original, the BMW 750i?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Would you prefer a turbocharged or rather a naturally aspirated engine? With the 7th generation Chevrolet Corvette, buyers were able to choose between either. What's the more convincing model variation, the Grand Sport or Z06? Also: the McLaren 720, with its 4-litre BiTurbo V8. And: taking part in the "Bavaria Sportwagen Tour" with an AMG GTR.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you had the choice to select three cars for every occasion, which models would receive a spot in your garage? We took a look at the Rolls Royce Phantom, the Aston Martin DBS Superleggera and the Audi RS4 for this little mindgame.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2018, the Audi R8 Quattro Performance received an upgrade. The new version shared some of its aerodynamic features with the Lamborghini Huracan. Also: the Porsche Macan S got a more powerful engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The rebirth of French chic: the elegant DS 9 from Citroen's luxury brand. Plus: the Genesis GV80 offers luxury at a low price. And: a test drive in the exorbitantly expensive Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: Volvo S90
programme.desc: It looks sportier than one might expect from the Swedes. The taillights frame the powerful looking rear. On the inside, the Volvo S90 impresses with the finest materials and soft nappa leather.

programme.title: Alfa Romeo 6C 2500SS
programme.desc: Founded in 1910, the iconic Italian car manufacturer Alfa Romeo experienced a very eventful history. Their 6C 2500 SS model is right in the middle of the company's more than 100-year history. It combined new technology with an early post-war appearance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the GTR, Nissan tried to take on the established European sports car manufacturers. For less than half the price the GTR was a more affordable direct competitor to Porsche's 911 Turbo S or the Audi R8 GT. In addition: one of the ultimate super cars, the Techart 911 Turbo S with 620 hp. And: the Pagani Huayra, presented and driven by Formula 1 Pilot Adrian Sutil.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: It's not always a car's pure power that makes driving through curves exciting. The Subaru BRZ with its low boxer engine and its well-balanced handling gives his driver a very good feeling for the road. The BMW 235i RS has a great rear wheel performance and the Porsche Cayman GTS with its mid-engine puts a smile on your face as soon as you put your foot on the accelerator.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the creation of its i8, Munich-based car manufacturer BMW makes a big step towards the future. After all, the futuristic looking car is the first German sports car which utilizes hybrid technology. Supercars checks out the BMW i8 on the streets of Los Angeles. But BMW did not just work on the i8. They also present the new sports coupe 435i and the sporty SUV X550d M.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you have only sat in the back of a big limousine and if you don't know how much these kind of limousines are, you are probably part of the management. When it comes to driving experience and performance, it makes sense that the driver¿s seat is less attractive. But that's only the case for seasoned state cars anyways. The Audi RS and Mercedes S-Class might even make some chauffeurs unemployed.

programme.title: Car History

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Ford Mustang is the icon of all sports coupes and convertibles - no other car conveys so much the lifestyle of the 1960s. With its striking shape and powerful engines the Mustang drove itself into the hearts of millions.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland or the British royals, they all drove the Austin Mini. Designed on a napkin, the Mini starts an incredible career in 1959: the revolutionary Mini is considered the prototype of all small cars.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: A car that everyone knows and that almost everyone has ridden in, a car that has conquered all continents and bears an unmistakable nickname, the Volkswagen Beetle.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Ferrari - the name alone raises the pulse. No other sports car has as much magic and myth as the fiery red icons from Maranello. Whether on the road or on the race track, these cars are the centre of attention.

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Porsche is like a religion! The faiths: Punk, technology and racing. Porsche punk Magnus Walker preaches individualism for historic vehicles. Technology has been embodied by Alois RUF since 1983. And for the racers, there is the GT3 RS.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: BMW tries to combine the electric future with fuel-saving features in the i8. In addition: the 'Race Chip' is tested on a 3,000-kilometre route. And: What is the benefit of the switchable performance enhancement from DTE Systems?

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: They are the US car icons par excellence: Chevy, Ford Mustang and Corvette. At Race 61, fans of historic racers pay homage to their heroes. And: we explore the history of the Ford Mustang up to the current model.

programme.title: Harley-Davidson Trio
programme.desc: We took a look at three very different Harley-Davidson models. The versatile Switchback Dyna, the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, and the bad-boy motorcycle Softail Slim.

programme.title: KTM 990 Adventure
programme.desc: It's very big and mostly comes in orange: the KTM 990 Adventure. Over rough terrain it's often driven standing up. Today, the 990 is considered the off-road specialist among travel Enduros.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: At the Essen Motor Show over 500 exhibitors present the latest highlights from the car tuning scene. Everything can be found here, from accessories available to everyone to handmade sports cars and top class tuning.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Abt Sportsline stands for car tuning at the highest level. Abt's slogan isn't 'from the race track to the road ' for nothing. Also: the Rohte VW Golf R20. And: the BMW Art Car.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: We visited Brabus, the largest independent automobile tuner where you can find more than 9,000 HP in one place. Also: MTM's Audi RS6 Clubsport.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Berlin-based company TH Automobiles equips Volkswagen vans with Porsche engines, turning a T5 into one of the most dynamic large saloon cars in the world.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Conti Tuning Day is themed "Power Sedans" and we take a closer look at the cars on display. Plus: Swiss eccentric Ueli Anliker has built the most expensive Mercedes-AMG SLR in the world, the "Red Gold Dream".

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Gemballa specialises in refining Porsche models, but its portfolio also includes brands such as Ferrari. And: the car tuning company Irmscher turns the Chevrolet Camaro into the 'Irmscher Camaro i42'.

programme.title: Porsche 550 RS Spyder
programme.desc: Small, lightweight, agile and swift as an arrow. Historic image documents of the Porsche 550 RS Spyder.

programme.title: BMW 750i xDrive
programme.desc: The BMW 750i is the second most powerful car in the 7 series. It may be mercilessly overpowered for the daily commute to work, but thanks to this power the two-ton vehicle doesn't feel as heavy as it actually is.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Robust, honest, simple, the Land Rover is the bedrock of all off-road vehicles. Built in 1948 as a simple car for British farmers, the vehicle quickly became an export hit. Today, the Land Rover is at home all over the world.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Vive la différence: the cars of Renault are always unusual in design, exceptional in their driving comfort and often avant-gardistic. Renault writes history with the Dauphine, R4, R5 and R16 models.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: From the very beginning, Citroën celebrated the joy of extravagance. Already the Traction Avant from the 1950s is a milestone in automotive history and the 2CV is one of the most unusual and charming small cars ever built.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Golf is nothing more but a reasonable car - there's nothing really exciting about it, but still it's a mega-seller. The Golf is compatible with the masses and dominates the compact car class since its market introduction.

programme.title: UFA 458 - Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 2 from Transylvania, Romania. In this episode Fernando Martin from Spain and Romania's Andrei Leustean face off in a super middleweight division bout. Next up the co-main event in the heavyweight division, Hungary's Sandor Kertesz takes on Romania's Bogan Stoica. In the main event USA's Omar Moreno steps into the ring with hometown favorite Andrei Ostravanu for a rematch in a supermiddleweight fight.

programme.title: UFA 468 - Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 1 from the Sala Polivalentă BT Arena in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. First up in the light-heavyweight division, undefeated Paul Danci takes on Alex Andreescu. Next up undefeated Eric Bubuleandra versus Becali Bodescu face off in the cruiser-weight division. In a heavyweight bout Bogdan Besta steps into the ring with Vasile Corcodel who looks to remain undefeated against his significantly heavier opponent. The main event features a super-cruiserweight bout between Italy's Frank Kanate and Romania's Stean Latescu.

programme.title: UFA 469 - Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 2 from the Sala Polivalentă BT Arena in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. First up, a bout in the cruiserweight division with Madalin Mogos versus Sebastian Lutaniuc. Achilles Karapiperis and Calin Petrisor "The KO Hunter" step into the ring to face off in a middleweight division fight. In an open weight entertainment fight Justitiarul De Berceni makes his professional debut against veteran fighter Tolea Ciumac "The Tiberian Bear." In the co-main event Netherland's Chris Baya faces Romania's Florin Lambagiu in a supermiddleweight division fight.

programme.title: UFA 478 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Starting off in the welterweight division, Ionel Balan takes on Adrian Maxim under superfight K1 rules. In a super middleweight bout, Andei Varga and Bogdan Takacs step into the ring while Valentin Bordianu and Cristian Conea meet up for a heavyweight match. Eduard Gafencu and Florin Lambagiu take to the ring in the co-main event in the light-heavyweight division under superfight MMA rules - boxing with MMA gloves.

programme.title: UFA 349 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 1 from Bucharest Romania. Watch four kickboxing battles on this episode of UFA. Starting out The Ironman, Denis Ceausu takes on Marius Cimpoeru, then Ali Gokturk Benli faces Andrei Leustean in a Turkey versus Romania bout. Florentin Ionescu takes on the more experienced Mihai Zmarandescu and Omer Pisgin takes on fan favorite The Shephard, Bogdan Nastase.

programme.title: UFA 350 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 2 from Bucharest Romania with a night of Kickboxing action. Starting off in the heavyweight division, Poland's Dominik Jedrejczyk takes on Romania's Claudiu Badoi in a David versus Goliath fight. Next up, Stefan Orza and Eduard Gafencu look to give fans a fight of the night. In two heavyweight matchups, Florin Ivanoaie faces Cristian Ristea and Ionut Iancu faces Sebastian Cozmanca.

programme.title: UFA 372 - Dynamite Fighting Show 22 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 22 part 1 from Romania. Watch as Andrei Varga "The Bonecrusher" faces Adrian Maxim in a youth versus expierence bout where the winner will move on in the tournament. Also fighting to stay in the tournament are Darius Argyo and Valentin Mavrodin, Marius Cimpoieru ("Berzerk") and Marian Lapusneanu ("The Terror") and in the fourth quarterfinal fight Costel Schiopu versus Alex Bublea.

programme.title: UFA 390 - Muay Thai For Life 8 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Muay Thai for Life 8.0 part 1 from Sweden at the Rondo Liseberg Center. Starting off in the lightweight division Filip "El Capitan" Lindgren from Stockholm faces hometown favorite Noak Wollsater in a rematch. In the female division, watch as two time Swedish kickboxing champion Joanna Camacho gets into the ring with Janet Kling, two time Swedish Muay Thai silver medalist while Oscar Lindkvist and Simon Vinterskog from rival gyms take to the ring. Also tonight Peter Wallin, K1 champion, takes on Andreas Hall in the light heavyweight division.

programme.title: UFA 391 - Muay Thai For Life 8 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Muay Thai for Life 8.0 part 2 from Sweden at the Rondo Liseberg Center. Starting off this episode in the middleweight division Cedrik Von Heiroth faces opponent Viktor Schiller. In a female bout, Ewin Ates and Lisa Larsson both with no defeats take to the ring and Sam Wingqvist is matched up against Sam Ghoroghi in a lightweight match.

programme.title: UFA 392 - Muay Thai For Life 8 Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Muay Thai for Life 8.0 part 3 from Sweden at the Rondo Liseberg Center. Buckle up for a brawl in the super heavyweight division as Swedish Muay Thai champion Mattias Lundkvist takes on Zvonimir Kralj "The Croatian Sensation." Also on this episode Alexander Jansson faces Muay Thai champ Poramin Atsa in a middle weight bout while in the co-main event, Colombia's Nico Sanabria takes on Amir El-Dakkak. In the main event Denmark's Youssef Assouik, multiple World Champion, takes on Anton Sjoqvist, Muay Thai World Champion from Stockholm in the super middleweight division.

programme.title: UFA 502 - Dynamite Fighting Show 32 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2 The Battle of Moldova from the Sala Polivalentă in Iași, Romania. Starting off is a Superfight in the lightweight division between Emi Lupașcu and Damir Popovici followed by a Suprfight in the Super Middleweight division with Tudor Potoroacă versus Francesco Carbotti. This episode also features the Championship matchup in the DFS - K1 90 kilo World Grand Prix tournament, the winner will move on to comptete in the World Grand Prix in Japan. In the main event is Florin Lambagiu versus Cristian Ristea - it's the Gladiator versus Rambo with 40 knockouts betweeen them facing off in a Superfight in the open weight division.

programme.title: UFA 488 - Fighters Only 17th World MMA Awards
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Fighters Only 17th Annual World MMA Award Show from Las Vegas hosted by UFC Hall of Famer Chael Sonnen. The fan-voted event covers the sport’s biggest performances and major storylines over the last year featuring star-studded presenters and features the major performance categories such as knockout of the year and fight of the year as well as the lifetime achievement award. Presenters include Maxx Crosby, Neal McDonough, Akbar Gbaja-Biamila, Frank Mir, Bella Mir, Millennium All Stars, Jon Anik, Valentin Chmerkovskiy, K-La Duncan, Nina Drama, Lochlyn Munro, Natalie Lind, Dr. Octagon and Shawne Merriman

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Florida Super Regional 2024 - Kennesaw State University vs. Georgia Tech
programme.desc: Experience the high-stakes intensity of a "Battle for the Bid" at the 2024 DUPR Florida Super Regional in Port Saint Lucie. This match pits the seasoned Kennesaw State Owls against a surprising Georgia Tech squad that is brand new to the tournament scene. Despite Kennesaw entering as the heavy 80% statistical favorite, the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets delivered a stunning wake-up call with a dominant 21–9 victory in Women's Doubles. Now, the Owls must lean on their powerhouse Men’s and Mixed Doubles teams to claw back and keep their championship dreams alive. With a direct invitation to the Collegiate Pickleball Nationals in Dallas on the line, every point is a fight for survival in this premier regional showcase.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Bengaluru - Day 12 Tie 2
programme.desc: The road to the championship reaches a fever pitch at Mumbai's Jio World Garden for the second semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2. In this high-stakes "penultimate tie," the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans face off against a hungry Delhi Dilwale squad led by coach Wesley Gabrielsson. Witness a clash of styles as the dominant Katerina Stewart, who has lost only one match all season, battles the passionate Alejandra Lopez in a critical women's singles opener. Tactical brilliance is on full display as Max Mantor and Trang Huynh attempt to dismantle the Jawans' defense in a high-scoring mixed doubles "exhibition". With every strategic "Pickle Play" and intense baseline rally potentially deciding who advances to the grand finale, the atmosphere is electric and the margins for error are razor-thin.

programme.title: NCPA San Diego Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - UCLA vs. SDSU
programme.desc: Welcome to Week 3, Day 1 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025, live from the Barnes Tennis Center in the heart of San Diego, California. This highly anticipated state rivalry pits the UCLA Bruins against the SDSU Aztecs in a crucial best-of-seven collegiate team match.The match format prioritizes singles, with UCLA winning the coin toss and opting to start with Women's Singles. The broadcast features the Women's Singles match between Mae Lee (UCLA) and Emily Miller (SDSU), and the Men's Singles where SDSU's Preston Lynch takes a commanding early lead. The match also includes Gender Doubles, where SDSU (the Aztecs) took an early 3-0 lead in the overall match score. The winner of this pool play match gains a strong position for seeding, moving closer to securing one of the National Championship bids.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Escramble
programme.desc: In a time beyond and close to now... a vision was revealed. A vision of the very first dream of life. The dream of life before there was life. The dream that vapor dreams of becoming solid and falling to meet whatever will catch and hold it. Thus begins "ESCRAMBLE". Featuring Bjorn Leines, Terje Haakonsen, Mark Landvik, Wille Yli-Louma, Shaun White, Seth Huot, Gigi Rüf, Erik Leines, Bryan Iguchi, Chris Demolski and Jamie Lynn.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Back Yard Boogie
programme.desc: Terje Haakonsen rips his back yard on the snow-skate and Rip Zinger...well, yeah he gets creative too.
